title: Agent Loop metrics event
description: Authored here (#20, #64). One line of .agent-loop/metrics.jsonl, written by scripts/agent-loop-supervisor and scripts/agent-loop-gh, and summarized by scripts/agent-loop-report. Times are Unix epoch seconds.

event.description: supervisor_start/supervisor_exit: the Supervisor process; session_start: a session was launched; nudge (count: nudges in this episode so far); stall: nudges failed, an agent-loop-stall issue was filed and the session restarted; restart: the context restart (pct set); shutoff: no work, the session was ended; claimed: this machine's label first seen on an issue; delivered: an issue this machine claimed closed as completed (issue and seconds set, plus pr, merged_at and review_rounds when its merged PR was found); unclaimed: an issue this machine claimed lost its machine label; rate_limit: the x-ratelimit-* headers of one REST call; budget_hold: the Supervisor began holding new work because the REST budget was low; budget_unknown: it began a stretch with no usable budget reading, so the hold failed open; checkout_scan: how long the lsof scan of the session checkout took before a start.

seconds.description: delivered: from first seeing the claim to the close; checkout_scan: the scan's duration.

count.description: nudge: nudges in the current episode, this one included.

pr.description: delivered: the merged PR from agent-loop/<machine>/<issue>.

review_rounds.description: delivered: distinct PR head SHAs that received a review-verdict.
